name: AREA FACTOR
body: The determinant tells how much areas grow: det = 2 means every shape covers twice as much.

name: SAME AREA
body: Leaning a shape (a shear) keeps its area: same base, same height, det = 1.

name: NEGATIVE AREA
body: A negative determinant means the plane was turned over, like in a mirror.

name: SQUASHED
body: det = 0: î and ĵ point along the same line and the whole plane is flattened onto it.
